name: jlc-hardware-agent
description: MVP CLI that turns a constrained hardware request into a validated EasyEDA Pro .eprj3 project.

scripts.generate:led: node src/generate.js --template 5v-led-indicator --input "5V LED 指示灯板" --out dist --force
scripts.generate:rc: node src/generate.js --template rc-low-pass-filter --input "RC 低通滤波器，输入输出测试点" --out dist --force
scripts.verify:client: npm run verify:client:led && npm run verify:client:rc
